geo_rule: A building address is an organizational/location receipt only. It does not prove a person was physically present unless an event-specific source says so.
meeting_rule: Transcript time and participant identity do not establish the physical room unless the transcript or another official source states the location.

dc_gap_summary: Wiles access: exact date/time/location/schedule and legal authority for access remain unclosed in the official public record located in this pass.
White House-DOJ handoff: no event-level public receipt located that maps specific White House access to a specific DOJ review/redaction action.
Maxwell interviews: exact transcript times and participants are public; the transcript does not state the physical room/building.
Maxwell transfer: origin/destination facilities and sequence are public; exact approval, waiver, decision, and transport timestamps remain incomplete.
DOJ 3.5M-page production: organizational publication is public; reviewer-by-reviewer location, custody path, and collection manifest are not supplied by the press release.
OIG audit: process is under audit, but the final report has not yet closed the gaps.
